expectations.text: Clearly states that there is no database system or SQL migrations in this project
expectations.evidence: Line 28: 'No contiene ningún sistema de base de datos propio ni migraciones SQL reales'. Line 30: 'No existe ninguna base de datos operativa, ORM, driver de base de datos'

expectations.text: Does NOT describe or invent a database system, ORM, migration framework, or SQL files that don't exist
expectations.evidence: Correctly classifies all SQL-related findings as: (1) empty fixture directories, (2) eval fixture with in-memory SQLite, (3) pedagogical examples in small-safe-steps. Never claims any are part of the project.

expectations.text: Mentions that the project uses file-based persistence (thoughts/ directory with markdown files) as the actual storage mechanism
expectations.evidence: Section 5 (line 117): 'El mecanismo de persistencia que usa el proyecto es el sistema de ficheros a través del directorio thoughts/'
